title: Build a typographic landscape and travel through one letter

motion.summary: HIGHEST follows the crest of a drawn hill above GROUND. The composition then enlarges until the opening in the O reveals the next ocean scene.
phases: Establish a quiet contour field with a short connector line.
Shape the key word around the same hill and anchor the noun below.
Reveal a different scene within a letter counter, then enlarge the typography until that scene takes over.
motion.transferablePrinciple: Give typography the same spatial logic as its subject, then use its geometry as the doorway to the next world.
variations: Curve a constellation name around an orbital path and enter a letter opening into the sky.
Build a city silhouette from a title and pass through a window-shaped counter.
Use a solid cut-paper hill or sculpted letters to avoid repeating this contour-line treatment.
cautions: Hold the complete words before the push crops them.
Select a letter opening with enough area to reveal the next scene.
Do not reuse this exact hill, font arrangement, or photographic destination as a preset.

quality.reviewer: agent visual inspection of decoded frame sequence
strengths: Word shape, terrain and transition all support the same idea of physical scale.
The pale graphic scene contrasts clearly with the dark photographic destination.
limitations: The large letters intentionally leave the frame during the transition.
The contour-line style is only one rendering choice and can become repetitive across a song.
Observed from six decoded frames of the exact hashed MP4; this is a concept reference, not full motion, audio-sync or whole-film acceptance.
